question: In a certain code language, 'VIOLATES' is written as 'TALOVIES'. How will 'VELVETIN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'VIOLATES' is written as 'TALOVIES',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6b26b0c6a30f9992efaac462e413ff743e68268bb54d96fae6616e8b5c502a9.png] 

Similarly, for '**VELVETIN**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d36d52dc097a1a0e23acb4aa7144d0536510798bb1b73a24d29d11d836915b4.png] 

So, 'VELVETIN' will be written as '**TEVLVEIN**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
